artifact.why: Removes the Artifact tool (publishing pages to claude.ai), about 34 KB on every request.

workflows.why: Removes the Workflow tool and workflow skills, about 5.4 KB per request; workflows are multi-agent fan-out, the most expensive way to spend a plan.

loops.why: Removes the cron tools and ScheduleWakeup (self-paced /loop), about 4.6 KB per request; every wake-up is a full turn over the whole context.

report-findings.why: Removes ReportFindings, about 2.2 KB per request; only Claude Code's /code-review uses it, and dotclaude's reviewers report in text.

advisor.why: Removes the advisor tool. Each call reads the whole conversation without the cache, and counts toward plan limits.

explore-plan.why: Removes the built-in Explore and Plan agents, which run on the main model; dotclaude's agents cover their jobs.

bundled-skills.why: Removes the skills and workflows bundled with Claude Code from the skill listing sent every turn; built-in slash commands stay.

auto-memory.why: Stops auto memory, which loads its index into every session and writes memory files.

refusal-retry.why: Stops the automatic extra request after a refusal.

builtin-plugins.why: Turns off the built-in plugins that add context or hooks to each session, and turns on You should know, a side agent that flags problems that Claude misses. A project that keeps AGENTS.md can link CLAUDE.md to it.

skill-descriptions.why: Cuts each skill description in the skill listing to 300 characters. The listing goes with every request, and the default cap is 1536.
